endpoints.title: Finding the nearest vehicles
endpoints.description: This API allows you to search for vehicles within a specified radius from a given point, sorted by distance. It is useful for rapid response scenarios (e.g., police, emergency services), where operators need to quickly determine which vehicles are closest to an incident location.

parameters.name: cmd=get_nearest_vehicles
parameters.description: command to get nearest vehicles

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: ID of the vehicle group (orgdep.id)

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: latitude of the target point (from −90 to 90)

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: longitude of the target point (from −180 to 180)

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: search radius. Supports values like 500M, 1KM, 10KM, 20KM, or a numeric value in meters

endpoints.title: Notifications configuration
endpoints.description: This API is used to create, retrieve, update, and delete notification configurations in the OneGPS system. This API is not intended for sending notifications.
